vless.not_vless: this is not a vless:// key
vless.unsupported_protocol: the {name} protocol is not supported yet
vless.bad_uuid: the user ID (UUID) has an invalid format
vless.encryption_why: sing-box can't do it; an Xray adapter is needed (planned)
vless.unknown_param: parameter “{key}” is not supported and was not applied
vless.grpc_multi: gRPC multi mode is not supported by sing-box, the regular one is used
vless.xhttp_modes: Xray knows only auto, packet-up, stream-up, stream-one
vless.reality_pbk: REALITY needs the public key pbk
vless.reality_pbk_format: the REALITY public key (pbk) has an invalid format
vless.reality_sid_format: the REALITY short id (sid) has an invalid format
vless.no_fingerprint: fingerprint fp is not set — using chrome, as Xray does
vless.allow_insecure: the key asks not to check the server certificate (allowInsecure) — this way you could end up on a fake server
vless.no_tls: the key has neither TLS nor REALITY — traffic would go unprotected
vless.extra_too_big: the extra parameter is too large
vless.extra_not_object: the extra parameter must be a JSON object
sub.timeout: the subscription server is not responding (20 s timeout)
sub.host_not_found: the subscription server address was not found — check the link and your internet
sub.status: the subscription server answered with code {code} (404 — the link is wrong or the subscription was deleted)
sub.too_large: the subscription is larger than 1 MB — that doesn’t happen, refusing to read it
sub.too_many_lines: the subscription has more than {max} lines
sub.placeholder: a service line of the subscription, not a server
sub.not_a_key: the line doesn't look like a key
sub.html: the server sent a web page instead of a list of keys
sub.json_why: only a list of keys is understood for now
sub.not_base64: the response looks neither like a list of keys nor like base64
store.unknown_link: this is neither a subscription link (https://…) nor a vless:// key
store.plain_http: the link starts with http:// — without encryption it can be swapped on the way; https:// is required
store.duplicate: this source has already been added: “{name}”
store.too_many: there are already {max} sources — remove the extra ones
store.busy: the storage has been busy with another copy of ninja-vpn for more than 10 s — try again
store.server_missing: Server “{name}” not found — update the list.
verify.no_response: the server is not responding: not a single test site answered within {secs} s. The cause may be blocking, a network failure or the server itself
verify.no_path:
not a single test site opened through the server
{details}
verify.stalled:
there is a connection through the server (exit: {exit}), but the transfer breaks off: the 64 KB test download didn't arrive from any site
{details}
verify.bad_format: the response has an unexpected format
engine.missing: core file {path} not found — reinstall ninja-vpn (in the development folder: scripts\fetch-engines.ps1)
engine.exited:
the core stopped right after starting:
{details}
engine.port_timeout: the core didn't open local port {port} within 5 seconds
engine.manifest_version: engines.json has {name} {version}, but the engine builds configs for {expected}
session.log_tail:
Last lines of the core log:
{tail}
protect.encrypt: couldn't encrypt the data with the built-in Windows encryption (DPAPI)
protect.decrypt: couldn't decrypt the data with the built-in Windows encryption (DPAPI)
apps.windows_part: it is part of Windows — it is not routed through the VPN
apps.not_program: it is not a program (an .exe file or a shortcut to one is needed)
apps.missing_moved: program not found — it was deleted or moved
apps.pick_title: Which program should go through the VPN?
apps.shortcut_not_program: This shortcut doesn't point to a program.
apps.shortcut_target_missing: The program this shortcut points to was not found.
apps.not_in_list: The program is not in the list.
apps.did_not_close: the program didn't close — close it yourself and try again
apps.did_not_start: the program didn't start — try again
winsys.activation_unavailable: the Windows launch manager is unavailable ({code})
winsys.uac_denied: administrator permission is needed — Windows didn't get it
winsys.uac_cancelled: cancelled: Windows didn't get administrator permission
tun.other_vpn: Another VPN is on (“{name}”). Two whole-computer VPNs get in each other’s way, and neither will have internet. Turn off other VPNs and click “Connect” again. The “Browser” and “Apps” modes are not affected by the other VPN.
tun.other_vpn_started: Another VPN turned on (“{name}”) — ninja-vpn disconnected so the two VPNs don’t leave the computer without internet. To come back, turn off other VPNs and click “Connect”.
pair.no_lan: No home network found (Wi-Fi or cable), so the phone has nothing to connect to. Connect the computer to Wi-Fi or a router.
pair.bind_failed: Couldn’t open the page for the phone: {why}
pair.page_lead: Paste a vless://… key or a subscription link — it will appear in ninja-vpn on the computer right away.
pair.page_done: Done: “{name}” is now in ninja-vpn on the computer. You can send another one or close this page.
pair.page_empty: Paste a key or a link.
tun.helper_silent: the TUN helper exited without reporting anything
app.tun_failed: Couldn't turn on the “all programs through VPN” mode: {why}
app.no_servers: No servers to connect to — update the list.
app.all_failed:
Couldn't connect to any of the {n} servers.
{details}
app.browser_did_not_close: {name} didn’t close — close it yourself and try again.
app.browser_did_not_start: {name} didn’t start the right way — try again.
app.reason_no_data: data stopped flowing through the server
app.tun_stopped: The “all programs through VPN” mode has stopped.{detail}
